On-demand GPU hours: H100 SXM $1.99, H200 $2.99, B200 $4.99, B300 $5.49, L40S $1.49; CPU $0.015/h unit ambiguous on website. Shared storage $100/TB-mo, object $50/TB-mo+$0.005/1000 requests; no ingress/egress fee for object storage. Reservations/enterprise quoted. Conditional $20 GitHub-star credit not universal.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

2026-09-29: API backend engine.tensorpool.dev returns 503 'TensorPool is no longer accepting API requests.' The docs.tensorpool.dev subdomain no longer resolves (no DNS record). The YC directory lists status 'Acquired' (acquirer not named). The last blog post is 2026-03-31, the last CLI commit 2026-04-13 and the last PyPI release 0.0.9 on 2026-03-29. The pricing page is still live but no longer actionable.

fleet.tiers: Standard advertises on-demand access up to 128 GPUs; Enterprise advertises thousands through contact.
fleet.notes: 128 is published Standard-plan GPU ceiling, not reserved inventory or proof of bypassing billing/anti-abuse checks. CPU/instance quotas, verification and review time not published.
